# Steps to reproduce the problem
V8 14.6.199 (commit 01d64e2c6be), Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04.

1. Build d8 with DrumBrake enabled. Use the following args.gn:

    v8_enable_sandbox = true
    is_asan = true
    is_debug = false
    symbol_level = 1
    v8_enable_drumbrake = true
    v8_enable_webas
